errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

badRequest.title: The request was not accepted
badRequest.body: Some of the details sent were missing or not valid. Go back, check them and try again.

unauthorized.title: Sign in to continue
unauthorized.body: You are not signed in, or your session has ended. Sign in again and you will come back to this page.

forbidden.title: Your role can't open this page
forbidden.body: This page belongs to another role. Go to your own home page, or ask an admin if you need access.
forbidden.prerequisite: The role this page is for

notFound.title: This page isn't in the catalogue
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved. Check the link or start again from your home page.

tooMany.title: Too many attempts
tooMany.body: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

server.title: The server couldn't finish this
server.body: Something failed on the ACOPS server, not on your side. Try again in a moment.

offline.title: Can't reach ACOPS
offline.body: Your device can't connect to the server. Check your connection, then try again.

crash.title: This page stopped working
crash.body: Something in the page failed while loading. Reloading usually fixes it.

placeholder.title: Page under construction
placeholder.body: This page is routed and ready to be built.
